definitions.gloss: to come along; to arrive; to show up
definitions.explanation: Someone or something comes to a place, with a nuance of finally arriving or appearing. Often used for people visiting or arriving at a location.

definitions.gloss: to come (of a time, season, or event)
definitions.explanation: A time period, season, or event arrives or approaches. Used for abstract things that come with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|き}た。
{遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|く}る。

⟦{野良猫|のらねこ}→野良猫：14440_noraneko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やって{来|く}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: A stray cat comes to our garden every day, so I ended up giving it a name.

ついに⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|き}た。
examples.english: The day of the exam has finally arrived.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|き}て、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧だ。
examples.english: The long-awaited summer vacation has arrived, and the children are overjoyed.

notes:
USAGE:
More vivid and emphatic than simply ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧. Suggests that the arrival takes some effort or distance, or that it is notable or eagerly anticipated. Very common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|く}る (spring comes)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やって{来|く}る (a guest arrives)
- ついにやって{来|き}た (it finally arrived)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come — neutral and general, while やって{来|く}る adds emphasis or a sense of distance
